rules.fol:
fof(lsr6_lift, axiom,
  ! [T, W] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 3) => ? [S2] : (suspended_load(S2) & under(W, S2, S))) )
      => alert(line_of_fire, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is for at least 3 seconds under a suspended-load then VisionGuard raises a critical line-of-fire-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Line of Fire alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 6) about the worker when:
the worker is under a suspended-load for at least 3 seconds
rules.text: If a worker is under a suspended-load for at least 3 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical line-of-fire-alert for the worker.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr6_red, axiom,
  ! [T, W, R, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & pipe_handling(R)
        & exclusion_zone(Z) & zone_id(Z, 'Red-Zone')
        & in(W, Z, T)
        & have(Z, R, T) )
      => alert(line_of_fire, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is in Red-Zone and Red-Zone has a pipe-handling then VisionGuard raises a critical line-of-fire-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Line of Fire alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 6) about the worker when:
Red-Zone has a pipe-handling (from the drilling control system)
rules.text: If a worker is in Red-Zone and Red-Zone has a pipe-handling then VisionGuard raises a critical line-of-fire-alert for the worker.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr9_edge, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & height_zone(Z) & zone_id(Z, 'Deck-Edge')
        & near(W, Z, T) )
      => alert(working_at_height, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is near Deck-Edge then VisionGuard raises a critical working-at-height-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Working at Height alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 9) about the worker when:
the worker is near Deck-Edge (within 1 m)
rules.text: If a worker is near Deck-Edge then VisionGuard raises a critical working-at-height-alert for the worker.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr0_fall, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( fall_pose(W)
        & walkway(Z) & zone_id(Z, 'Deck')
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 2) => in(W, Z, S)) )
      => alert(person_down, high, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a fallen-person X1 is for at least 2 seconds in Deck then VisionGuard raises a high person-down-alert for the fallen-person X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a high Slip, trip or person down alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 0) about the fallen-person when:
the fallen-person is in Deck for at least 2 seconds
rules.text: If a fallen-person is in Deck for at least 2 seconds then VisionGuard raises a high person-down-alert for the fallen-person.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr0_ppe, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & walkway(Z) & zone_id(Z, 'Deck')
        & in(W, Z, T)
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 2) => ~ (? [H] : (hardhat(H) & wear(W, H, S)))) )
      => alert(ppe, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is in Deck and it is false that the worker X1 wears a helmet for at least 2 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical ppe-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Missing PPE alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 0) about the worker when:
the worker is not seen wearing a helmet for at least 2 seconds
rules.text: If a worker is in Deck and does not wear a helmet for at least 2 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical ppe-alert for the worker.

semantics.alert lifecycle: per (rule, subject): IDLE -> ACTIVE when the rule's antecedent holds (alert raised once, with proof) -> COOLING when it stops holding -> IDLE after cooldown_seconds; re-raised only from IDLE
semantics.counts: 'at least N workers' requires N distinct believed objects that satisfy every condition on them
semantics.duration: 'for at least D seconds' means the believed condition held at every frame time in [T-D, T]; 'for more than D seconds' is the same with a strict bound
semantics.evidence: a detected fact (object, zone membership, relation) stays believed for grace_seconds after it was last observed; a fact never observed, or not observed for longer than grace_seconds, is believed absent
semantics.fol: each rule's 'fol' is a TPTP fof formula over believed facts at time T; the head is alert(Lsr, Severity, Subject, T)
semantics.negation: 'does not wear a harness' holds when no harness is believed associated with the subject; negated visual conditions require a duration (positive-evidence policy)
semantics.time: rules are evaluated at every frame time T
